perspective:
From Brandon’s perspective, the available information is:

- I am Brandon Talayumptewa, an Alaska Native insurance agent with a bachelor’s degree. I know myself as cautious and detail-oriented.
- I know Benjamin Erickson as an entrepreneur seeking business insurance advice. I am aware he has limited formal education.
- First meeting: I met Benjamin professionally. He said he wanted comprehensive business coverage but some terms were new. I explained liability insurance and asset protection using examples—slip-and-fall liability, inventory/equipment protection. He said it made sense, asked about assets, and thanked me for breaking it down.
- Second meeting: Based on our prior interaction, I revised my belief about his ability to understand detailed information and felt confident going deeper. I explained business interruption and property insurance. He said he was ready, had been reading up, found business interruption crucial in unpredictable times, and found comprehensive property/theft coverage reassuring.
- Casual lunch: I worried I was too caught up in details and wanted to keep things engaging. Benjamin said he appreciates thoroughness and enjoys lighter moments. I told a joke about insuring taste buds; he was fascinated. I connected it to risk assessment for his business, and he agreed it was less unusual but equally important.
- Later meeting: Pleased by his positive response, I offered additional support beyond insurance. I suggested strategic investments to lower premiums and security upgrades to reduce costs. He said my insights were invaluable, hadn’t considered it, called it a win-win, and wanted to explore it further.
- Joint venture proposal: Encouraged by our rapport, I proposed co-developing a platform integrating risk management with financial planning for entrepreneurs. He agreed, called it groundbreaking, said our combined expertise could set us apart, and suggested drafting initial plans.
- I know our relationship is professional and has evolved through these interactions; we have found common ground in dedication to our careers.
